sources.title: Seed library storage
sources.text: The seed library stores dry seeds in paper envelopes. Each packet records the harvest year. A blue dot marks a packet ready for exchange.

sources.title: Catalog rules
sources.text: Volunteers sort the catalog by plant name. A borrowed packet stays in the catalog until its return is recorded.
